evals.name: header-select-deltas
evals.prompt: For hathor#185: list exactly what has to change in our org select so it matches the data-provider select in NPlan's header. Don't edit anything yet, just the deltas with file refs on both sides.
evals.expected_output: A delta list pairing enki's Header/SelectProvider source with hathor's SelectOrganisation, in hathor idiom, with the e2e id preserved.

assertions.text: Cites enki's src/scenes/App/Header/index.tsx and/or src/scenes/App/SelectProvider/SelectProvider.tsx as the reference
Names the three deltas: transparent/outlined instead of white-filled, visible floating label, light border/text/caret on the navy bar
Does not propose adding Redux, react-intl or Apollo to hathor

evals.name: where-does-it-live
evals.prompt: in nplan the active provider is kept somewhere global and every list refetches when it changes. where is that in their code, and what's our equivalent?
evals.expected_output: Points at enki's userContextSlice / activeProviderCode and maps it to hathor's OrganisationsContext.currentOrganisation.

assertions.text: Maps it to hathor's OrganisationsContext / useOrganisationsContext currentOrganisation
Uses the Provider ≈ Organisation vocabulary mapping
Read enki source (local ../enki or raw.githubusercontent.com) rather than answering from memory

evals.name: theme-token-port
evals.prompt: Our info colour and h1 size look off next to NPlan. Bring those two theme values in line with theirs.
evals.expected_output: Edits hathor's theme JSON (not a new TS theme) so info.main and h1 match enki's Entur CustomTheme.

assertions.text: Reads enki's src/ext/Entur/CustomTheme/theme.ts for the values
Sets info.main to #0082b9 and h1 to 34px (600 / 42px line-height) or equivalent
Changes land in .github/environments/theme-*.json, not in a new TS theme file
Updates every theme-<env>.json consistently, not just one
